full_judgment:
Md. Sirajul Islam J: This Rule under section 115(1) of the Code of Procedure was directed against the judgment and order dated 7-5-1995 passed by the Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Lakshmipur in Title Suit No. 143 of 1994 rejecting the plaintiffs' prayer for addition of party. 

 2. The petitioner No.1 as plaintiff filed Title Suit No.45 of 1989 in the Court of Subordinate Judge Lakshmipur against opposite party Nos. 1 and 3 others for declaration of his title to the suit land described in the plaint and for an other declaration that the suit land is not vested and non-resident property. On transfer of the suit suit to the court of the Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Lakshmipur, it was re-numbered as Title Suit No. 143 of 1994. Thereafter the opposite party No. 2 filed an application under Order 1 rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure in the court of Subordinate Judge, 2nd Court, Lakshmipur on 20-9-1994 for adding him as defendant No. 5 in the suit which was allowed by the court making him defendant No.5 Plaintiffs' case is that he purchased the suit land for recorded tenant Haripada Das by registered kablala dated 31-8-1973 and has been possessing the same since his purchase by way of his own right and adverse possession and paying rent to the Government. But subsequently on 1-9-1988 he came to know that the suit land has been declared as vested and non-resident property vide VP Case No. 109/28 of the year 1976-77. Haripada Das never left this country and the suit land is not vested property.
